owner.summary: Karol Bagh mein ek bujurg akele hain, tabiyat kharab hai
owner.suggested_action: Report logged and prioritised. Residents can document the issue with photos; suggested volunteers are listed.
owner.complaint_draft:
To,
The Officer-in-Charge, Local RWA / NGO + Delhi Social Welfare Dept.

Subject: Urgent civic issue - Elderly & Vulnerable Help at Karol Bagh

Residents of Karol Bagh have reported the following: "Karol Bagh mein ek bujurg akele hain, tabiyat kharab hai". This is affecting daily life and public safety in the area. We request inspection and resolution within 48 hours and a status update to the complainant.

Regards,
Delhi Community Radar (on behalf of residents)
